cases.provenance: A user reported this defect after the reviewed pull request, and a later fix repaired it.
cases.summary: Preview & View services amputate ids with a hash character "#"
cases.description:
### To Reproduce
Configure a reconciliation service that returns URIs as IDs. 

Hovering over reconciliation suggestions,  automatically matched values and manually mapped values will fail to retrieve the preview information as ID contained in the callback is truncated.

evidence.eventual_fix_title: Fix URI encoding for View and Preview services
evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
Fix URI encoding for View and Preview services

Fixes #3730

Changes proposed in this pull request:
- encode reconciliation item IDs using encoreURIComponent so special characters like # used in URIs are properly encoded.
